parsed.rationale: All four records are empty interfaces (fields_or_signature: []) flagged as exact-duplicates with shared_field_count: 2, spread across three consumer packages (Playback, Wallpaper, MusicShareKit) and one foundational package (Analytics). The Analytics package already declares AnalyticsEvent in Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift, making it the natural parent; the three domain-specific variants (PlaybackAnalyticsEvent, QualityAnalyticsEvent, RequestLineAnalyticsEvent) should inherit from it rather than redeclare the same shape independently. Because the shared members are structural/empty, no members need to be physically moved — the inheritance relationship itself eliminates the duplication. None of the records carry any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false).
